links.comparator_used: AI score presented alone without FDR/FOR error rates
links.effect: Recall was higher with AI scores alone than with scores plus FDR/FOR (odds ratio 2.9, 95% CI [1.331, 6.417], p=0.0077); confidence was higher when FDR/FOR were provided, particularly at intermediate scores (U-shaped relationship with score).
links.quote: In the decision-making study (n=21; 20 assessments per radiologist), recall increased with AI score in both conditions; however, recall was higher when AI scores were presented alone compared with scores accompanied by FDR/FOR (odds ratio 2.9, 95% CI [1.331, 6.417], p=0.0077).

design_hint: presenting locally calibrated error rates (FDR/FOR) alongside AI scores
